component.name: ABCarus
component.summary: Edit, render, and play ABC notation

description.p: ABCarus is a desktop editor and toolkit for ABC notation. It combines text editing with an engraved score view and playback, so notation can be written, checked, and rehearsed in one workspace.
It supports multi-tune ABC files, Library browsing, set lists, MusicXML import and export, printing, practice loops, and configurable microtonal notation and playback.
